tasks.subject: Add typed native selector fragment and matcher model
tasks.description: Implement Phase 3 selector lowering metadata in internal/promshim/native by extending leaf fragments with repo-owned selector source information, typed matchers, time-bound requirements, and explicit instant/range selector contracts. Keep this scoped to selector leaves used by the current native subset.

tasks.subject: Implement repo-owned selector SQL rendering and matcher lowering
tasks.description: Add storage/native SQL builders that render selector sources using timeSeriesData(...) and related TimeSeries relations, compile metric/equality/inequality/regex/negative-regex matchers into typed predicates, and apply evaluation-range bounds from native analysis.

tasks.subject: Route native subtree rendering through selector sources and add tests
tasks.description: Update native fragment rendering so current native aggregation/unary/scalar-arithmetic paths use repo-owned selector leaf sources instead of delegated PromQL, then add tests for matcher-to-SQL lowering, selector output contracts, bounded fetches, and native explain/render behavior.
tasks.activeForm: Routing native rendering through selector sources

tasks.subject: Add optimizer-owned selector predicate and projection state
tasks.description: Implement Phase 4 optimizer state on selector-backed native fragments so passes can mutate effective selector predicates and projection requirements rather than only reporting strings. Include inferred/pushed matcher tracking, required tag-label state, and rewrite metadata for the current native subset.

tasks.subject: Use optimizer passes to tighten selector SQL and flatten wrappers
tasks.description: Update selector and renderer SQL generation so Phase 4 passes materially change the rendered SQL for the current native subset: push inferred predicates into deepest selector sources, avoid unnecessary tag materialization/timeSeriesTags joins where safe, and flatten redundant source wrappers while preserving semantic barriers.
tasks.activeForm: Tightening selector SQL and flattening wrappers

tasks.subject: Add Phase 4 optimizer pass tests
tasks.description: Add optimizer-focused tests for Phase 4 proving predicate pushdown into selector SQL, safe matcher inference, projection pushdown reducing tag materialization when safe, redundant wrapper elimination, no SELECT-star SQL, and preserved aggregation semantic barriers.
